sources.note: Main vendor site. Describes product suite (GlaceEMR, GlaceRCM, GlaceOffice, GlaceScribe, GlaceGrow, GlacePhoneSmart, GlaceBillSmart). Claims 25+ years operation, hundreds of clients. Targets solo to large practices across specialties.
GlaceEMR product page. Details AI-integrated documentation, scheduling, lab/device integration, regulatory compliance (MIPS/MACRA/PCMH/ACO), CCM and RPM modules, specialty templates.
GlaceRCM product page. Describes full billing lifecycle: eligibility verification, charge capture, claims submission, denial management, A/R tracking, patient balance collection, analytics.
GlaceOffice product page. Practice administration suite: HR, recruiting, credentialing, payroll, bookkeeping, payment gateway, email/fax routing, IT infrastructure, HIPAA audits.

Behavioral health specialty page. Details group therapy management, mental health screening templates (PHQ-9, BIMS, Mini Mental Status Exam), DSM-5 assessments, treatment plan tracking, EPCS with biometric verification, telehealth.

ONC transparency disclosure. Lists GlaceEMR 6.0 as cloud-based certified EHR. Describes pricing tiers (GlaceBasic through GlaceComplete). Base includes clinical documentation, eRX, patient portal, hosting. Add-ons for Direct Trust, UpToDate, EPCS. EHI export in CSV/HTML/PDF/XML formats.

Product documentation page. Describes GlaceEMR modules, two-way data flow between clinical and billing, integration with Multum Lexi-Data and SureScripts, smartphone app. Mentions serving practices, surgical centers, and hospitals.
Alternate product site. Describes comprehensive telemedicine module, integrations with partner healthcare entities. Mentions GlaceComplete, GlacePremium, GlaceEnterprise tiers.

Third-party EMR review site. 3/5 rating across 11 reviews. Users praise intuitive design, workflow efficiency, template customization. Criticisms: system slowness, occasional freezing, outdated interface, support delays.

FindEMR profile. Lists specialties (cardiology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology, surgery, psychiatry). Pricing from $54/mo. Notes lab integration, mobile access, patient portal. 0 user reviews on site.
Capterra profile (403 blocked on fetch). Search results indicate mixed reviews with praise for ease of use and criticism for outdated interface.
SoftwareFinder profile. Describes unified scheduling, documentation, billing, and patient portal under one umbrella.
Company profile data. Estimated $17.3M revenue, 162 employees, headquartered in Waterbury, CT. Founded 1998.
